description: This file defines the TrialBalanceRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories to manage TrialBalance entities. It includes a custom query method to retrieve new trial balance records based on office and account IDs.
external_methods: Query(value = "select * from m_trial_balance where office_id=:officeId and account_id=:accountId and closing_balance is null order by created_date, entry_date", nativeQuery = true)

classes.name: TrialBalanceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for TrialBalance entities, providing CRUD and custom query operations.

methods.name: findNewByOfficeAndAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TrialBalance records for a given office and account where the closing balance is null, ordered by creation and entry dates.
